name: fleet-tracker
title: Fleet Tracker
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A vehicle list with selection and location details, loading its map lazily. Use it as the lighter fleet view when a full map is not needed up front.
docs: Named export: FleetTracker. Uses next/dynamic with `ssr: false` to defer the map, so it needs Next.js. Installs standalone with no registry dependencies. For the full map view, use `fleet-map`.
